title: Gentle web settings
brief: Settings screen that replaces the terminal-only /gentle:customize. Groups: Appearance, Editing, Permissions, Workflow, Privacy. Each setting runs its gentle-shell command silently, shows the current value from its status, and never adds messages to the chat.

artboards.title: Modal with section nav
artboards.tradeoff: Familiar and focused, with a left section list; hides the chat while open

artboards.title: Full page
artboards.tradeoff: Roomy and easy to scan with room for explanations; leaves the chat and needs a back button

artboards.title: Side drawer
artboards.tradeoff: Chat stays visible so changes can be seen live; narrow, controls stack and long labels wrap
